requirements.text: The system must allow users to colour-code their timetable modules.
The system must allow users to hide cancelled classes in their timetable.
The system must send pop-up notifications to users' phones or through the app when grades are released.
The module feedback system must allow users to provide overall feedback on the module, including content quality, teaching effectiveness, and resource helpfulness.
The module feedback system must be available immediately after the term ends to allow users to provide fresh feedback.
The system must focus on improving user experience as a priority.
